title: 板壁打开髋部
description: 赛璐璐画呈现宽而不夸张的脚距，让身体自然面对板壁。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: Create an original cel-animation illustration of a fictional adult using a comfortable open-hip stance on a gentle indoor slab. Two positive low footholds sit slightly wider than shoulder width, and broad handholds at chest height allow relaxed assistance. The knees follow the shoe directions naturally, with no extreme split or forced turnout. Compose the full figure in a frontal wide view so the stance, lightly angled wall, and continuous crash mat remain clear. Use crisp dark teal outlines, warm apricot wall surfaces, and soft yellow highlights. Clothing is opaque and unbranded. The action is controlled and close to the floor, without jumps, lettering, or dramatic exposure.
